name: The Hidden Key
summary: Tucked away in the binding of Bookie Herod's ledgers is a small brass key alongside notes referencing a secure strongbox. Locating this container deep within the cavern complex behind Kurzen's Compound may reveal how Private Thorsen was betrayed.

sections.title: A Secret in the Bindings
sections.body: Searching through Bookie Herod's ledgers yields no direct mention of Private Thorsen, but it reveals something else: a small brass key concealed inside a book's binding. Scraps among the paperwork make passing mention of a secure strongbox tucked away inside the Stockpile, the cavern complex at the rear of Kurzen's Compound. Opening that container might reveal how Thorsen's cover was blown.

sections.title: Deep into the Stockpile
sections.body: Reaching the strongbox requires delving into the cave system behind the compound. Heavy, bronze-bound, and sturdily constructed, the chest sits among stacked crates in the cave.

faq.q: Where did this brass key come from?
aliases: how did i get the key
faq.answer: The small brass key was hidden inside the binding of one of Bookie Herod's ledger books, uncovered while examining his paperwork.

faq.q: Where is Bookie Herod's strongbox located?
faq.answer: The strongbox sits inside the Stockpile, which is the cave complex found at the very back of Kurzen's Compound.
Herod's loose papers fail to explain how Private Thorsen's presence was compromised, but they mention a secure strongbox that might hold the answer.
This follows the investigation into Bookie Herod, where his ledger records were first sought out and searched.
